name: International TMTV Benchmark, lymphoma FDG PET/CT (60)
what: International TMTV Benchmark, lymphoma FDG PET/CT, 60 subjects, Zenodo 13255214 published 2024-08-07, about 6.9 GB; the NIfTI CTs on the PET grid are over 3 mm, so the DICOM is wanted
level_truth: counted by the census pipeline once fetched
status: planned in the data platform at bf1432f; fetch job in the 2026-10-21 chain once a zipped-DICOM convert route is written
how_to_get: Read the record listing and choose the include pattern, then spinesurg-ct-nnunet's tools/acquisition_fetch.py zenodo --collection tmtv_benchmark --record 13255214 --include '<pattern>' (md5-verified) through slurm/acquisition_fetch.sh; the download works with --include '\.zip$', but a zipped-DICOM convert route must be written first.

The route as the manifest prints it: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py --grid zenodo_tmtv_benchmark; on the grid, from ~/spinesurg-ct-nnunet/data_platform/reacquire, sbatch -D "$PWD" --export=ALL,IDS="zenodo_tmtv_benchmark",MODE=--run reacquire.sbatch, as a Slurm job on the owner's word.
